name: Air Fryer Chickpea Sweet Potato Bowls with Tahini Yogurt

components.name: Crispy Chickpeas

ingredients.name: Canned chickpeas, drained and patted dry

steps: Thoroughly dry cooked canned chickpeas and coat in oil, coriander/chili and salt.
Air fry chickpeas at 190 C for 10-15 minutes, shaking frequently until crisp; avoid burning small beans.
Portion sweet potatoes and chickpeas into four hot-meal containers and pack peppers, spinach and yogurt tahini sauce separately. Do not freeze fresh spinach or sauce.

components.name: Sweet Potato Cubes

ingredients.name: Raw sweet potatoes, peeled and cubed

steps: Heat air fryer to 190 C. Toss raw sweet potato cubes in measured oil and spice and air fry in batches for 15-20 minutes until tender with browned corners.

components.name: Peppers, Spinach & Tahini Yogurt

ingredients.name: Raw spinach leaves for fresh serving

steps: Chop raw bell peppers and wash spinach, keeping all fresh vegetables cold.
Whisk yogurt, tahini, lemon and water into a pourable dressing.
